notes.title: Typo Fixes and FPS Limit Added
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed several typographical errors.
[*]Added a limit to the maximum FPS, now capped at 120 FPS.
[/list]

notes.title: BugFix
notes.content:
Fixes:
・The achievement “My...” was not unlocking properly.
・After losing a battle, the screen would remain black and the game would no longer progress.

notes.title: Demo Save Data Can Now Be Carried Over
notes.content: [h2]Notice[/h2][p]The demo has been updated, and save data can now be carried over directly into the full version of the game.[/p][h2]Important Note & Apology[/h2][p]Please note that save data from the demo [i]before[/i] this update cannot be used to continue the story.[/p][p]I apologize for the inconvenience and kindly ask that you use the skip feature or similar options to catch up.[/p]
